name: Viggo
description: A human knight-like hero who fuses with a symbiote and then destroys the town he previously protected.

timeline.summary: Viggo, once protecting a boy, fuses with a large black symbiote and destroys the town he used to defend.
timeline.quote: After joining with the symbiote he is seen destroying the town he previously was protecting.
